text.tspan: ALB or EC2 as an origin: public network vs VPC origins
Risk: the origin still has a public address anyone can try.
• No public IP on the origin: only CloudFront can reach it
• The VPC still needs an internet gateway attached
• Not supported: Gateway LB, NLB with TLS listener, gRPC
• "Serve a private app in private subnets through CloudFront without exposing it" → VPC origin.
• Older questions (before VPC origins): public ALB/EC2 whose security group allows only CloudFront's IP ranges, or a custom header check.
• S3 private content → OAC. Private ALB/NLB/EC2 → VPC origin. Public HTTP server → custom origin.
